Types.Description: Holding the information about how the yard is configured (entities, streets).So this sctructure contains all the information about what action may be performed at the yard andhow the navigation can be performed.

Types.Name: EOrderActionType
Types.Description: An OrderActionType defines the action of the order to perform.

EnumValues.Name: Loading
EnumValues.Description: Loading means that some material has to be loaded (taken from storage location)

EnumValues.Name: Unloading
EnumValues.Description: Unloading means that some material has to be unloaded (put into storage location)

Types.Name: Task
Types.Description: A Task defines a single step of a process that is required to be fullfilled.To perform a task it is required to identify the entities providing the required action and if specified, only entities that are allowed for this task.

Properties.Name: Action
Properties.Description: The action defines an activity to be performed. Entities provide Actions that can be performed.

Properties.Name: Remark
Properties.Description: A remark for the human reader for better understanding the configured task

Types.Name: Process
Types.Description: Describes a process which can be used by a truck-order.

Properties.Name: Ident
Properties.Description: The unique name of the process

Properties.Name: Material
Properties.Description: The material that can be handled by the process or '*' when any material can be handled

Properties.Name: Action
Properties.Description: The action or actions that can be handled by the process.

Properties.Name: Remark
Properties.Description: Some remarks for the human reader

Properties.Name: Tasks
Properties.Description: The List of tasks that are required to perform for this process in given order-direction

Types.Name: Order
Types.Description: Defines a order in simulation-mode. An order can be read as: [offsetMinutes] min after start a truck with license-plate [licensePlate]arrives to [action] (load/unload) [quantityKg] of [material]

Properties.Name: offsetMinutes
Properties.Description: The offset (in minutes), at which the truck should be recognized for simulation

Properties.Name: licensePlate
Properties.Description: License-plate of the truck, is used to identify the order/truck

Properties.Name: action
Properties.Description: The action to perform (loading / unloading)

Properties.Name: quantityKg
Properties.Description: Quantity of material to handle (in kg)

Properties.Name: material
Properties.Description: The material that should be handled in this order/by this truck

Properties.Name: OrdersOverall
Properties.Description: Quantity of orders overall

Properties.Name: OrdersUnhandled
Properties.Description: Quantity of unhandled orders

Properties.Name: OrdersIncomplete
Properties.Description: Quantity of incomplete orders

Properties.Name: OrdersCompleted
Properties.Description: Quantity of completed orders.

Properties.Name: Summary
